description: An HTML file that provides the user interface for visualizing and interacting with database data, including dynamic loading of databases, tables, and table data, with interactive features such as expanding cell content and refresh controls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the current selection.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads the list of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell, handling long content and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content to show full data.
